trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as a checklist rather than a task: finish the story, clear the one missable meditation in Chapter 1 first, then work the activities and collectibles in the roadmap order below. Launch-week guides put the full run at roughly 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the Chapter 1 missable (Positive Mental Attitude) before it closes.
Work activities and collectibles to 100% — the platinum follows.

trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is unmissable: play through the intro and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Use it to learn the driving, shooting and switching controls — nothing here can be failed permanently.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission through to its end.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order. Before you wrap the chapter up, do Lucia's balcony meditation — it is the game's only confirmed missable (see Positive Mental Attitude) and it disappears once Chapter 1 ends, so make a manual save first.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1 missions to the chapter's end.
Before the final Chapter 1 mission, meditate on Lucia's balcony and save manually.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing its missions in order. Story trophies like this one cannot be missed — if a mission fails, replay it from the checkpoint and keep going.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play Chapter 2 missions through to the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its missions in order. One warning inside this chapter: the Strangers & Freaks strand 'Race Against Yago' carries an hourglass icon and is time-sensitive, so do it while Chapter 3 is current rather than leaving it for after the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3 missions through to the chapter's end.
While in Chapter 3, do the time-sensitive 'Race Against Yago' stranger strand.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing its missions in order. By this point the map is fully open, so it is also a good moment to start the longer activity grinds (stunts, races, challenges) between missions.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play Chapter 4 missions through to the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It is the gold story trophy and it pops when the credits roll — no extra objective is needed beyond completing the mission itself.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the final mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story. Like every story mission trophy, it is unmissable: finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the Breakfast Run mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission when it appears in the story. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase first — follow the story prompts and the trophy pops when the heist itself is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play The Cartel Heist mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission when it appears in the story. Finish the mission and the trophy pops — no side objective required.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the Child's Play mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission when it appears in the story. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the Headliners mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission when it appears in the story. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the VCIA Takedown mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission when it appears in the story. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist. The confirmed pieces from launch-week guides are: the full story, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles discovered, and 8 bank vaults robbed — plus the collectible and activity sets. It is the last trophy most players earn, so treat it as the end of the roadmap, not a separate grind.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Reach 70 of 80 Challenges and 200 of 277 vehicles.
Rob all 8 bank vaults and finish the remaining collectibles.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — the jumps, airtime, near-misses and drifts the game scores as you drive. Stunts count anywhere in free roam, so they pile up naturally, and 300 are needed for 100% completion, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and long airtime in free roam.
Chain near-misses and drifts between stunts to keep the count climbing.
Keep going to 300 stunts for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game counts nine activity types — races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest of the leisure menu — and the trophy pops once you have sampled every type at least once. Nothing needs to be won, just tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play one round of each activity type the game offers.
Check the trophy progress after each new type until all nine are tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the game's two ranges. That is the confirmed count from launch-week guides. Work one challenge at a time: learn its gold threshold, practise until you clear it, then move on — the range lets you retry a challenge as often as you like.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Visit both shooting ranges and open the challenge list.
Gold each challenge, retrying until the gold threshold is met.
Clear all 42 across the two ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 drone-race locations. The confirmed count is 14 locations. You only need one win per location, so learn each course's line, win it once, and move on to the next.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win the race there.
Repeat at each of the 14 locations until every one is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word that matters is different: replaying the same race does not add to the count. Work through the race menu — road, off-road, water and air events are separate races — and bank a win in 20 distinct ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open the race menu and pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to the next unwon race.
Repeat until 20 different races are won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are scored catch contests, so the aim is a better haul than Cal's, not just any catch. Bring your best rod setup, fish the challenge through, and outscore him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Fish the challenge and finish with a better score than Cal.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play a cabinet game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest or easiest one you find and finish a full run of it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an arcade cabinet and start a game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock mission by mission as you meet the character around Leonida — work through Andy's missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Andy's stranger missions and play them in order.
Complete Andy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Kenton's stranger missions and play them in order.
Complete Kenton's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Work through Billy's missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Billy's stranger missions and play them in order.
Complete Billy's final mission.

trophies.at_risk: Time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 strand 'Race Against Yago' carries an hourglass icon — do it during Chapter 3.
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Most strands stay available after the story, but one is time-sensitive: the Chapter 3 strand 'Race Against Yago' carries an hourglass icon, so do it while Chapter 3 is current. The other seven strands can be finished at any point.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play stranger strands as they appear around the map.
Do 'Race Against Yago' during Chapter 3 — it is time-sensitive.
Finish 8 full strands in total.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Work through Randy's missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Randy's stranger missions and play them in order.
Complete Randy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Work through Tyrone's missions in order and the trophy pops when his last one is done.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find Tyrone's stranger missions and play them in order.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE CONFIRMED MISSABLE. Meditate at every spot across Leonida — and do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends, because it disappears afterwards and there is no mission replay, so a manual Chapter 1 save is required. The count in launch-week lists is 18 spots, but that number has NOT been independently re-verified: treat it as a working target and tick each spot off as you find it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: In Chapter 1, meditate on Lucia's balcony — and make a manual save first.
Find and meditate at every other spot across Leonida.
Work from the launch-week target of 18 spots (unconfirmed count).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's stranger strand builds to a single hunt: follow his missions to the end and the final mission is the hunt for that one specific animal.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play Bret's stranger missions in order.
Complete the final hunt for the unique animal.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. The 'three sets' figure comes from launch-week lists and has NOT been independently re-verified, so treat it as a working target: collect cards across Leonida, finish a set, and repeat until three sets are complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Collect cards found across Leonida.
Complete one full card set, then keep collecting.
Finish three full sets (count unconfirmed — verify as you go).

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The count of 100 comes from launch-week lists and has NOT been independently re-verified: use it as a working target and check the counter as you go. WAiNK spots are the photo/selfie points scattered around the map — interact with each one you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find WAiNK spots around Leonida and interact with each one.
Keep going toward the launch-week target of 100 (unconfirmed count).

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 Challenges in total and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is the halfway marker: work through the challenge list — driving, combat, exploration and leisure objectives — until 50 are done, then keep going to 70 for the platinum.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open the Challenges list and work through its objectives.
Complete 50, then keep going to 70 for 100%.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level up to four stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: With your partner present, raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and leave the search area.
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of a normal escape: keep the heat alive between robberies. Rob one shop, move straight to the next while the wanted level is still active, and do the third the same way — do not let the wanted level clear in between.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: With your partner, rob a first shop.
Move straight to a second shop while still wanted, and rob it.
Rob a third shop the same way, without the wanted level clearing.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Entering or driving a vehicle model you have not seen before logs it, and 200 of the 277 vehicles in the game are needed for 100% completion — so this trophy is the halfway point of a much longer collection. Grab every new model you pass.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Drive or enter vehicle models you have not logged yet.
Keep collecting new models until 100 are discovered.
Keep going to 200 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode — trigger it in a busy shootout with grouped enemies and drop five before it ends. Pick a fight with plenty of enemies close together rather than a one-on-one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a shootout with several grouped enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — get airborne from VCIA without going through a scheduled flight. In practice that means taking a plane from the airport and flying out yourself, rather than boarding as a passenger.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Vice City International Airport.
Take a plane and fly out — an unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tank ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'). The official text does not spell out the exact trigger, so this is a tank-encounter trophy: expect a feat involving Rhino tanks in free roam or a mission. Check the linked community guide for the confirmed trigger rather than guessing at it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Look for Rhino tanks in free roam or missions.
Check the linked guide for the confirmed trigger, then do it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid being spotted by staff, guards or cameras, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are seen, the attempt fails — leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Enter a jewelry store quietly.
Take the goods without being spotted.
Leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — and 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion, so keep going past this trophy. Each vault is a planned job: hit the vault, take the cash and lose the wanted level afterwards.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Rob a bank vault and escape cleanly.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed — then all 8 for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes in free roam: hit one, take the cash it carries, then lose the wanted level. You do not need a mission for this — it is a free-roam robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an armored truck in free roam.
Rob it, then escape and lose the wanted level.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every named area of the map. The total in launch-week lists is 52 areas, but that number has NOT been independently re-verified: use it as a working target and let the map fill in as you travel, checking off areas you have visited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Travel to every named area across Leonida.
Work from the launch-week target of 52 areas (unconfirmed count).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total across the gangs, so you have plenty of targets — the trophy only needs one per gang. Hit one operation for each of the nine gangs and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang you have not hit yet.
Rob it, then repeat for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take it in with the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to a spot overlooking Ocean Beach.
Have a cocktail there.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's glass front. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at it, and punch out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car out through its glass front.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. You do not need a perfect score: a full game at that specific alley is what counts.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' points to a partnership moment that draws a crowd, but no step is stated in the official text. Do not guess at it: the linked community guide tracks the confirmed trigger, so check it and follow that.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Check the linked community guide for the confirmed trigger.
Follow that trigger exactly.

trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. The PSN progress counter for this trophy runs to 500, so this is a long-haul tally: choices made across the story, stranger strands and activities all feed the count. Keep playing through everything else and it climbs on its own — there is no single moment that pops it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Keep playing story, stranger strands and activities.
Make choices as they come — the counter climbs toward 500.

trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm.' The description points at succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure — but the official text names no activity. The linked community guide tracks which attempt-based feat this is; check it rather than failing things at random.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Check the linked community guide for the confirmed activity.
Fail it once, then succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — a strange, out-of-the-ordinary event, the kind of one-off oddity other players report in free roam. The official text gives no location, so this one is found, not followed: the linked community guide collects the confirmed sighting, so check it before hunting.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Check the linked community guide for the confirmed sighting.
Go there and trigger the strange event.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The title and description point at the bowling alley and a drive-by melee hit: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock targets over like pins. The linked guide has the confirmed setup — check it for where to line the hit up.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Check the linked guide for the confirmed setup.
Land a melee drive-by hit that bowls targets over.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering until the $250,000 total is reached — it is a running total, not a single job.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Earn marked bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts toward the running total — clothes, food, weapons, car parts — so it climbs naturally as you play. If it is the last one standing, buy big-ticket items until the total tips over $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Buy from shops as you play — everything counts.
Top up with big purchases until $100,000 is spent.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties, at a total of roughly $160,000. Garages are bought from the property menu as they become available — buy each one when you can afford it and the trophy pops on the eighth.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Save up — about $160,000 covers all eight.
Buy each garage property as it becomes available.
Purchase the eighth and final garage.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, then register them through the app — ten registered vehicles pops the trophy. Any vehicles you already own or discover along the way count once registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register vehicles until 10 are on the app.
